title: Evaluation of large language models using an Indian language LGBTI+ lexicon

bias_targets.target: Sexual orientation and gender identity bias
bias_targets.methodology: Prompting language models with words from an Indian language LGBTI+ lexicon in both descriptive and offensive contexts, and manually evaluating the outputs across question-answering, machine translation, and hate speech detection tasks.

Assessing the limitations of evaluating multilingual capabilities via translation to English by demonstrating how models lose specific socio-linguistic nuances and queer-phobic intent when translating Indian language terms.

primary_bias_target: Sexual orientation and gender identity bias
